messages:
AlexM: Heads-up — customer reported being billed twice for trailing tokens after a reconnect/resume. They reconnected, stream resumed and we appear to have double-counted the resumed suffix. Logs pasted below.

AlexM: ```
2024-03-10T15:23:01Z host=svc-12 stream_id=abcd1234 conn_id=conn-88 request_id=req-9 offset=128 tokens_charged=42
2024-03-10T15:23:03Z host=svc-12 stream_id=efgh5678 conn_id=conn-89 request_id=req-9 resumed=true tokens_charged=42
```

Priya: Oof. Is this the old prefix-tracking dup we fixed last quarter or a new path?

JasonC: Can you paste the SDK/info? Is request_id preserved across reconnect? If yes, we should dedupe on request_id. If not, we need stream-level handling.

AlexM: Browser SDK: it kept request_id but generated a new stream_id on ws reconnect. Customer patch notes say they used the reconnect helper.

MartaL: Right now billing emits per-connection token totals from serving host. The serving runtime doesn't add canonical request_id to billing events in all code paths, so the billing pipeline can't join them.

Priya: So two possible failure modes: serving didn't attach request_id OR billing pipeline didn't dedupe when same request_id showed up twice.

JasonC: Quick grep: router emits billing_event {conn_id, stream_id, tokens}. Only some code paths add request_id. Toolcall/truncation paths may skip it.

AlexM: Confirmed — the truncated toolcall path posts a minimal event and omits request_id in a fast-exit branch.

Priya: 💥 That explains the double-count. If toolcall truncation exits early we lose canonical metadata.

MartaL: Options: 1) fix runtime to reliably attach request_id (small, quick); 2) add dedupe in billing pipeline based on request_id with TTL (bigger but robust); 3) change SDK to keep stream_id stable across reconnects (breaking change for some clients).

JasonC: For short-term mitigation: attach request_id in that fast-exit branch (runtime PR). Also add a routing-level debounce that collapses near-duplicate billing events (5s window) so the pipeline gets fewer dupes. I can handle debounce.

Priya: I'll take the runtime PR to ensure request_id is always present. Add a unit test that simulates truncated toolcall + reconnect.

MartaL: I'll own longer-term billing dedupe RFC (request_id join with 1h TTL and eventual audit log). Also adding metric: billing.duplicate_events.count by customer and request_id. Need dashboard + alert.

AlexM: Good. Also need console UX: surface per-request token traces so customer support can see both events and why tokens were charged twice. Can we wire a small trace tile?

MartaL: Yep. I'll add a trace widget that queries billing_events by request_id/time window and shows sequence. Low-effort MVP for SRE/CS.

JasonC: Router debounce — I'll implement an in-memory recent-requests cache keyed by request_id with 5s TTL. If we see an event within TTL, drop or merge tokens into the earlier event and emit a merged event flagged dedup=true. Tests + canary tomorrow.

Priya: One more edge: toolcall truncation. If a toolcall returns partial and is replayed by client, tokens for the tool output might be charged on both paths. We need to include toolcall_id on billing events too.

MartaL: Good catch. Add toolcall_id to billing schema and tests. I'll add it to the RFC as mandatory metadata fields: request_id, stream_id (optional), toolcall_id (optional).

AlexM: Action items: Priya -> runtime PR attach request_id + toolcall_id where available; Jason -> router debounce + merged-event flag; Marta -> billing RFC + dashboard + alert; I'll handle customer comms and provide ETA. :thumbsup:

JasonC: Canary deploy queued. deploy-bot: started canary for infra/router v2.1.3 (3 nodes).

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for infra/router v2.1.3 by JasonC — nodes: node-03, node-07, node-14.

AlexM: Thanks all. I'll tell the customer the immediate mitigation (upgrade SDK or avoid immediate reconnect) and that we have a patch scheduled.

Priya: Adding unit + integration tests now. Will tag AlexM and Marta for review.

MartaL: Adding dashboard tile and alert rule. Also adding a scheduled job to scan last 24h for duplicates per cust and surface top offenders.

JasonC: Pushed router debounce branch, tests pass locally. Will run canary tonight and monitor billing.duplicate_events.

AlexM: If duplicate counter spikes, let's revert or throttle. Keep me posted.

Priya: Noted. Also filing a follow-up RFC for stream-resume semantics in our API docs so SDKs can follow best practices.

MartaL: Done — created billing-dedupe RFC and added initial test cases for truncated toolcalls.

AlexM: Great work. Closing loop with customer in 2 hours.
